executive_summary.overview: Citigroup is executing a comprehensive multi-year transformation under CEO Jane Fraser to evolve from a sprawling financial supermarket into a simplified, services-led global banking powerhouse. The strategy centers on being the preeminent banking partner for institutions with cross-border needs.
